lines: Revenue was $12.14 billion, up 9% year over year, including 6% organic growth.
GAAP diluted EPS was $4.64, up 9%; adjusted EPS was $6.68, up 15%.
GAAP operating margin was 18.6%; adjusted operating margin was 24.5%.
The Ion 560 Chip launched with nearly twice the sequencing capacity of its predecessor for Ion GeneStudio S5.
